prior_work.local_assessment: Completed downstream in 6c5907b4 and carried in 0002; canonical record mos-near-index-overflow-proofs (fixed missed optimization) retains the baseline, census and runtime evidence. The 0065 prerequisite extraction explicitly excluded this pass. A pass-registration defect found during this extraction is recorded separately as mos-near-nowrap-option-clash.
prior_work.destination_assessment: Stock 06bc967d2668 has no MOSRecoverNearNoWrap, no canFoldNearIndex and no NoUWrap/NoUSWrap/hasW65816 checks in tryAbsoluteIndexedAddressing or selectIndirectAddressing; its MOS target does not reference LSR. The bank-wrap guard, and therefore the need for recovered proofs, arrives with patch 1. MOSIndexIV runs in the middle-end loop pipeline, before codegen LSR, and does not restore flags that LSR later drops. IRTranslator transfers GEP nuw/nusw to G_PTR_ADD NoUWrap/NoUSWrap.
prior_work.pipeline_assessment: #605 adds LLVM_MOS_EXPERIMENTAL_REGALLOC_DEFAULT (CMake option OFF) and -mos-experimental-regalloc. With the default, addIRPasses and the conventional register-allocation pipeline are unchanged apart from the new pass registration; the experimental allocator was not exercised with native widths or this pass.
prior_work.scev_assessment: The destination LLVM has SCEVUse use-specific no-wrap flags (86ab6d6e2ecf reports no in-tree setter yet). ScalarEvolution::getSCEV returns const SCEV *, so the pass reads node-level flags only.
